conflicts: CdSe baseline stock gives Se:Cd(CH3)2:tributylphosphine = 2:5:100 by mass; discussion separately describes Cd:Se about 1.4:1 by mole. Preserve both approximate descriptions without replacing either.
Main Figure 3 shows 8.5 nm CdSe by TEM; no demonstrated specimen join to the smaller-particle Figure 1/2 kinetic trajectory.
